# The path filter of ci.yml (.github/ci/changes.sh reads it; docs/develop/ci.md, "Path filter"). A row: a glob (`*`
# matches across `/`) and the jobs a change there can affect; the first row that matches wins, and a path no row
# matches runs everything. ALL: every job below. -: no job (the changes, scripts and gate jobs always run). rt-*:
# runtime.yml's jobs.
jobs: rt-linux rt-msrv rt-escape rt-containers rt-android rt-deny rt-fuzz rt-macos

# the output the workflow passes on: runtime.yml's `only`
list runtime: rt-linux rt-msrv rt-escape rt-containers rt-android rt-deny rt-fuzz rt-macos

# the workflows and CI's scripts, the hooks: everything
.github/*                     ALL
.githooks/*                   ALL
.gitignore                    ALL
# the Rust workspace and the data its tests read
crates/hub/fuzz/*             rt-fuzz
crates/*                      ALL
app/*                         ALL
xtask/*                       ALL
Cargo.toml                    ALL
Cargo.lock                    ALL
deny.toml                     ALL
etc/*                         ALL
settings/*                    ALL
packs/*                       ALL
test/*                        ALL
docs/develop/hub.md           ALL
# files nothing builds, installs, tests or reads (the leak scan, which reads every file, always runs)
docs/*                        -
README.md                     -
SECURITY.md                   -
LICENSE                       -
LICENSES/*                    -

# bite cases (changes.sh --self-test): PATHS | REQUEST | SELECTOR | RUN | PARTIAL
test crates/core/huginn/src/lib.rs       | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test Cargo.lock                     | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test .github/workflows/ci.yml               | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test test/container/nidhogg.sh              | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test some/new/place.txt                     | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test SECURITY.md                            | -        | -                | -     | false
test SECURITY.md,LICENSES/GPL-3.0.txt       | -        | -                | -     | false
test docs/develop/hub.md                    | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test crates/hub/fuzz/fuzz_targets/line.rs      | -        | -                | rt-fuzz | false
# narrowed dispatches: what the change needs and the run leaves out makes the run partial
test crates/core/huginn/src/lib.rs       | rt-linux | -                | rt-linux | true
test SECURITY.md                            | rt-linux | -                | rt-linux | false
